answer: The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, published publicly on failure, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Work waits on the voyage until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the river of the next round. The mesa of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
